text:
Nina: Need a focused webinar that ties a benchmark narrative to a launch playbook + clear lead flow. Goals: generate MQLs, demonstrate measurable wins, and have a repeatable follow-up path.
Omar: Suggest angle: "Benchmarks that move product decisions" 15-20m of benchmarks, then 20m of a how-to (runbook + LP).
Lena: Add a short customer vignette (2 slides) showing before/after metrics to make benchmarks credible.
Kai: Speaker slate: benchmark owner (Lena), product lead (Vik) for business impact, runtime engineer (eng-runtime) for demo. Ops: 10m pre-recorded demo clip as fallback.
Vik: Lead routing idea: gated runbook download -> qualification form with intent radio ("evaluating SLA" / "proof-of-concept"), map to SDR queues. Also tag by company size.
Lena: Landing page AB test: Variant A = metric-led headline, Variant B = outcome-led headline. Track conversion by UTM campaign and headline variant.
Omar: Email nurture: 1) immediate runbook + thank-you, 2) short clip + bench highlights day3, 3) invite to 1:1 eval day7. Use subject-line AB: technical vs buyer outcome.
Kai: Rehearsals: tech check 2 days before (30m), full dress 24h before (45m). Ops: confirm recording permissions and timecodes for the pre-recorded demo.
eng-runtime: We'll provision a 3-hour test cluster for the demo window. Ping exact model tags and KV flags.
Nina: Tasks: Lena = benchmark slides + customer vignette; Omar = LP copy + AB headlines; Vik = lead-routing form + SDR mapping; Kai = demo clip + infra ask; Ops-bot = create rehearsals.
ops-bot: Created invites: "Webinar tech check" Wed Jun 18 09:30 PDT, "Full dress" Thu Jun 19 09:00 PDT.
Nina: Good progress. Keep replies brief and tag owners when done. Add any blockers here.
